items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: actually he was back in New Orleans the first time I heard him, but before that, you know, he was with Bob Crosby.

ctx.x: That explains it. That explains it. That explains it. That explains it. That explains it.

Mm-hmm. And so, how did you get interested in music? Well, I've always liked jazz. The first time I heard it, and I think Fazola was about the first one I heard back in the late 30s, I guess. With, well, actually he was back in New Orleans the first time I heard him, but before that, you know, he was with Bob Crosby. But I was always crazy about his style from the first. In fact, that's the reason I took clarinet. Yeah. Did you know him well? No, I only knew him through Bress, actually. Bress took lessons from…
and to get interested? By what year would you say?
